readmeExcerpt:
# **omi** ### A 2nd brain you trust more than your 1st Omi captures your screen and conversations, transcribes in real-time, generates summaries and action items, and gives you an AI chat that remembers everything you've seen and heard. Works on desktop, phone and wearables.     [Website](https://omi.me/) · [Developer Docs](https://docs.omi.me/) · [Help Center](https://help.omi.me) · [Discord](http://discord.omi.me)
## What is Omi? Omi is an open-source AI wearable platform: a necklace that captures conversations, apps for phone and desktop, and a backend that turns what you say into memory you can search and chat with. The mobile apps, desktop apps, backend, firmware, and hardware designs are all open source in this repository (MIT); the hosted Omi Cloud service and paid plans are described at [omi.me](https://www.omi.me/). ## Quick Start ### macOS ```sh git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git && cd omi/desktop/macos && ./run.sh --yolo ``` Builds the macOS app, connects to the cloud backend, and launches. No env files, no credentials, no local backend. > **Requirements:** macOS 14+, [Xcode](https://developer.apple.com/xcode/) (includes Swift & code signing), [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) ### Windows ```powershell git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git cd omi\desktop\windows npm install copy .env.example .env npm run dev ``` Starts the Windows desktop app from source using the public config in `.env.example`. > **Requirements:** [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/) In a development worktree, run `make setup` once. It installs the Git hooks and syncs the pinned backend Python environment that some pre-push checks use. Mobile and desktop environments stay opt-in. ```bash make setup ```
Full Installation For local development with the full backend stack: 1. Install prerequisites ```bash xcode-select --install uv --version ``` 2. Clone and configure ```bash git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git cd omi/desktop/macos cp ../../backend/.env.template ../../backend/.env ``` 3. Build and run ```bash ./run.sh ``` See [desktop/macos/README.md](desktop/macos/README.md) for environment variables and credential setup. ### Mobile App ```bash cd app && bash setup.sh ios # or: bash setup.sh android ```

Try in Browser

How it works ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Your Devices │ │ │ │ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌───────────────────┐ │ │ │ Omi │ │ macOS App │ │ Mobile App │ │ │ │ Wearable │ │ (Swift/Python) │ │ (Flutter) │ │ │ └────┬─────┘ └──────┬───────┘ └────────┬──────────┘ │ │ │ BLE │ HTTPS/WS │ │ └───────┼────────────────┼───────────────────┼─────────────┘ │ │ │ ▼ ▼ ▼ ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Omi Backend (Python) │ │ │ │ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ Listen │ │ Pusher │ │ VAD │ │ Diarizer │ │ │ │ (REST) │ │ (WS) │ │ (GPU) │ │ (GPU) │ │ │ └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └─────────┘ └──────────┘ │ │ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │ │ │ STT │ │ Firestore│ │ Redis │ │ LLMs │ │ │ │ │ │ (DB) │ │ (Cache) │ │ (AI) │ │ │ └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └─────────┘ └──────────┘ │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` | Component | Path | Stack | |-----------|------|-------| | **macOS app** | [`desktop/macos/`](desktop/macos/) | Swift, SwiftUI, Python desktop backend | | Mobile app | [`app/`](app/) | Flutter (iOS & Android) | | Backend API | [`backend/`](backend/) | Python, FastAPI, Firebase | | Firmware | [`omi/`](omi/) | nRF, Zephyr, C | | Omi Glass | [`omiGlass/`](omiGlass/) | ESP32-S3, C | | SDKs | [`sdks/`](sdks/) | Device (Python/Swift/RN + multi-lang protocol) | | AI Personas | [`web/personas-open-source/`](web/personas-open-source/) | Next.js |
## Documentation Everything for builders lives at **[docs.omi.me](https://docs.omi.me)**: apps and webhooks, the Developer API, the MCP server, the CLI, SDKs, hardware, and how Omi works. End-user guides live in the [help center](https://help.omi.me). - [What is Omi](https://docs.omi.me/doc/get_started/what-is-omi) · [Choose your path](https://docs.omi.me/doc/get_started/choose-your-path) - [Developer API](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/api/overview) · [API reference](https://docs.omi.me/api-reference/introduction) - [Build apps](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/apps/Introduction) · [MCP server](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/mcp/introduction) · [CLI](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/cli/introduction) · [SDKs](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/sdk/sdk) - [Hardware & firmware](https://docs.omi.me/doc/hardware/OmiConsumer) · [Open hardware files](https://docs.omi.me/doc/hardware/consumer/index) - [Developer changelog](https://docs.omi.me/doc/reference/changelog) ## Omi Hardware Open-source AI wearables that pair with the mobile app for continuous capture.

- [Buy Omi](https://www.omi.me/pages/product) · [Buy Omi Glass Dev Kit](https://www.omi.me/glass) - [Hardware docs](https://docs.omi.me/doc/hardware/OmiConsumer) · [Open hardware files](https://docs.omi.me/doc/hardware/consumer/index) - [Flash firmware](https://docs.omi.me/doc/get_started/Flash_device) · [Integrate your own wearable](https://docs.omi.me/doc/integrations) ## Contributing Contributions are welcome: bug reports with reproductions, apps and integrations built on the platform, community ports, and core PRs. Read the [contribution guide](https://docs.omi.me/doc/developer/Contribution) and [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) first; [`PRODUCT.md`](PRODUCT.md) describes the product direction and invariants. Paid, team-posted [bounties](https://docs.omi.me/doc/contribute/bounties) appear on issues labeled "Paid Bounty 💰". Community: [Discord](http://discord.omi.me) · [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). User support: [help.omi.me](https://help.omi.me). readmeHtml:
omi

A 2nd brain you trust more than your 1st

Omi captures your screen and conversations, transcribes in real-time, generates summaries and action items, and gives you an AI chat that remembers everything you've seen and heard. Works on desktop, phone and wearables.

   

Website · Developer Docs · Help Center · Discord

What is Omi?

Omi is an open-source AI wearable platform: a necklace that captures conversations, apps for phone and desktop, and a backend that turns what you say into memory you can search and chat with. The mobile apps, desktop apps, backend, firmware, and hardware designs are all open source in this repository (MIT); the hosted Omi Cloud service and paid plans are described at omi.me.

Quick Start

macOS

git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git && cd omi/desktop/macos && ./run.sh --yolo

Builds the macOS app, connects to the cloud backend, and launches. No env files, no credentials, no local backend.

Requirements: macOS 14+, Xcode (includes Swift & code signing), Node.js

Windows

git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git
cd omi\desktop\windows
npm install
copy .env.example .env
npm run dev

Starts the Windows desktop app from source using the public config in .env.example.

Requirements: Node.js

In a development worktree, run make setup once. It installs the Git hooks and syncs the pinned backend Python environment that some pre-push checks use. Mobile and desktop environments stay opt-in.

make setup
Full Installation

For local development with the full backend stack:

  1. Install prerequisites
xcode-select --install
uv --version
  1. Clone and configure
git clone https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi.git
cd omi/desktop/macos
cp ../../backend/.env.template ../../backend/.env
  1. Build and run
./run.sh

See desktop/macos/README.md for environment variables and credential setup.

Mobile App

cd app && bash setup.sh ios    # or: bash setup.sh android

Try in Browser

How it works

│       │    BLE         │   HTTPS/WS        │             │

        │                │                   │
        ▼                ▼                   ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    Omi Backend (Python)                  │
│                                                         │

│  │ Listen  │  │ Pusher   │  │ VAD     │  │ Diarizer │  │
│  │ (REST)  │  │ (WS)     │  │ (GPU)   │  │ (GPU)    │  │

│  ┌─────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌─────────┐  ┌──────────┐  │
│  │ STT     │  │ Firestore│  │ Redis   │  │ LLMs     │  │
│  │         │  │ (DB)     │  │ (Cache) │  │ (AI)     │  │
│  └─────────┘  └──────────┘  └─────────┘  └──────────┘  │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
Component Path Stack
macOS app desktop/macos/ Swift, SwiftUI, Python desktop backend
Mobile app app/ Flutter (iOS & Android)
Backend API backend/ Python, FastAPI, Firebase
Firmware omi/ nRF, Zephyr, C
Omi Glass omiGlass/ ESP32-S3, C
SDKs sdks/ Device (Python/Swift/RN + multi-lang protocol)
AI Personas web/personas-open-source/ Next.js

Documentation

Everything for builders lives at docs.omi.me: apps and webhooks, the Developer API, the MCP server, the CLI, SDKs, hardware, and how Omi works. End-user guides live in the help center.

Contributing

Contributions are welcome: bug reports with reproductions, apps and integrations built on the platform, community ports, and core PRs. Read the contribution guide and CONTRIBUTING.md first; PRODUCT.md describes the product direction and invariants. Paid, team-posted bounties appear on issues labeled "Paid Bounty 💰".

Community: Discord · Code of Conduct. User support: help.omi.me. Business and legal: team@basedhardware.com.

aiSummary.oneLiner: An open-source wearable AI platform that acts as a secondary brain by capturing and summarizing daily interactions.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Omi is an advanced, open-source software ecosystem designed to power wearable AI hardware, effectively serving as a secondary memory bank. It continuously captures ambient audio conversations and screen data, processing it through real-time transcription models. The platform autonomously analyzes this continuous stream to generate contextual summaries, extract specific action items, and log everything into a highly searchable database. Users interact with this archived data via an intelligent chat interface that inherently understands their recent life events, bridging the gap between passive data collection and proactive personal assistance across mobile, desktop, and custom wearable devices.
keyFeatures: Real-Time Transcription Engine: Convert continuous ambient audio and conversations into highly accurate text instantly across multiple environments.
Contextual Memory Archiving: Store all transcribed interactions in a structured, searchable format, allowing the AI to perfectly recall past events and details.
Autonomous Action Item Extraction: Automatically identify and highlight tasks, commitments, or important notes from spontaneous, unrecorded daily discussions.
Ubiquitous Multi-Device Sync: Seamlessly synchronize captured data and AI context across custom open-source wearables, mobile apps, and desktop clients.
Proactive Conversational Interface: Interact with an AI assistant that actively utilizes the rich historical context of your personal data to provide highly relevant answers.

useCases.title: Comprehensive Life Logging
useCases.description: Allowing individuals to maintain a complete, searchable, and private digital archive of their daily conversations and critical decisions.

useCases.title: Automated Meeting Summarization
useCases.description: Enabling professionals to automatically capture notes and extract critical action items from spontaneous hallway discussions without manually recording them.

useCases.title: Accessibility Memory Augmentation
useCases.description: Providing users with memory impairments a reliable tool to instantly recall specific details, names, or commitments from past interactions.

useCases.title: Context-Aware AI Assistance
useCases.description: Empowering tech enthusiasts to converse with an LLM that requires zero prompting about recent context because it has already 'experienced' their day.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Quantified-self enthusiasts, hardware hackers, and high-productivity professionals comfortable deploying complex, multi-device software stacks linked to custom wearables. It is aimed at users who want to passively capture and organize their daily interactions and thoughts. The open-source nature allows for extensive customization of the transcription and processing pipeline.
